evals.prompt: add security scanning to our ci pipeline
evals.expected_output: Runs SAST and SCA/dependency scanning on every commit since they're fast, runs DAST against staging on a nightly or pre-release cadence since it needs a live target, and surfaces findings as PR comments/inline annotations rather than a separate portal.

evals.prompt: the team just started ignoring the pipeline, too many findings to triage
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses this as a fresh scanner turned on with blocking mode before tuning, and fixes it by running new scanners report-only first, triaging and suppressing the false-positive backlog with documented reasons, and only then flipping to blocking for new findings, gating solely on high-confidence/high-severity findings.

evals.prompt: let's turn on every scanner with default settings and block all merges on any finding
evals.expected_output: Pushes back: blocking on every finding including low-severity and unconfirmed ones before tuning trains developers to bypass the gate; recommends report-only mode first, triaging the initial backlog, and reserving hard blocking for high-confidence, high-severity findings only.
